annotations.title: Get official state auto insurance price benchmarks

description: Audited 2024-2026 sample auto insurance price spreads and cheapest open-market carrier win counts from 10 official US state insurance department (.gov) publications (53,685 quotes across 1,303 standardized profiles in CA, TX, MD, KY, NV, AL, OK, ND, WV, and DC). Pass a state code/name for one jurisdiction (with official .gov rate-guide URL and top carriers) or omit state for the 10-jurisdiction overview. States without a current carrier-level .gov table return an explicit unavailable explanation and the NAIC state regulator directory. Use for state-level .gov market spreads and carrier win counts; use check_auto_carrier_quality for insurer financial strength ratings, or compare_auto_quotes to normalize caller-supplied quotes. Factual benchmark data only; does not produce personalized quotes or endorse insurers.

coverage_type.description: Filter multi-state overview to 'full_coverage' or 'minimum_liability'. Ignored when a specific state is requested.

include_carriers.description: Include top open-market carrier win leaderboard for a requested state (default true).

max_results.description: Cap the number of carrier rows (for a single state) or state rows (for the overview).

state.description: Two-letter US state code or full state name (e.g. 'CA', 'Texas', 'DC'). Omit for the 10-jurisdiction overview.

name: get_state_auto_benchmarks

state.description: Requested jurisdiction benchmark details and official .gov rate-guide URL.

states.description: Jurisdiction benchmark rows when requesting the multi-state overview.

study_metadata.description: Metadata for RateZip's 10-jurisdiction 53,685-quote official .gov auto study.

top_carriers.description: Top open-market cheapest carrier win counts for a single state.
